description: Intent i009 (SNAPSHOT=s04, branch drm-userif-divisor) complete with one high-confidence finding. Finding: drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c, smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm(), lines 1196-1217. The function's only validation is `if (speed == 0)` (line 1207) on the raw u32 input, but the actual divisor is the fixed-width expression `(8 * speed)` in 32-bit arithmetic at line 1217 (`tach_period = 60 * crystal_clock_freq * 10000 / (8 * speed);`). For any speed in [0x20000000, 0xFFFFFFFE] the product 8*speed wraps modulo 2^32 to 0 (e.g. 8 * 0x20000000 == 0), so a nonzero validated input becomes a zero divisor at the exact division width -> kernel divide-by-zero oops while programming CG_TACH_CTRL TARGET_PERIOD — structurally identical to the seed vega10 bug. Untrusted source: hwmon fan1_target store (amd/pm/amdgpu_pm.c amdgpu_hwmon_set_fan1_target, kstrtou32 with no range check) -> amdgpu_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm -> amd/pm/swsmu/amdgpu_smu.c smu_set_fan_speed_rpm, whose only upstream guard is `speed == U32_MAX` (line 2758), which does not block 0x20000000-range values; dispatch reaches smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm for SMU v11 ASICs (navi10_ppt.c:3589, sienna_cichlid_ppt.c:3199). Key counterevidence checked: all five sibling implementations of the identical computation carry the wrap guard `(!speed || speed > UINT_MAX/8)` — smu7_thermal.c:270, vega10_thermal.c:315 (the patched seed site), vega20_thermal.c:194, smu_v13_0.c:1229, arcturus_ppt.c:1270 — smu_v11_0.c uniquely omits it, confirming the gap is not defended elsewhere. Other candidates classified safe: si_dpm.c:6744 (u8-derived fan_min/max_rpm <= 255 keeps 8*speed far below wrap), nouveau therm fan.c:162 do_div by timer delta not user numeric, sclk_od/mclk_od handlers (smu7_hwmgr.c:5105, vega20_hwmgr.c:1504) divide by constant 100 with the user value clamped to 20 as multiplicand. Limitations: bounded to the DRM tree of s04 only; no runtime reproduction (arithmetic wrap verified analytically, no SMU v11 hardware); trigger requires root-writable hwmon node and AMD_FAN_CTRL_MANUAL, same trust boundary as the seed CVE; non-DRM ioctls and firmware-table parsing are separate intents. Final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i009.json with snapshots_checked=["s04"], checkpoint updated.
